scope: Primary supplementary qualifications, not extra course coverage. No software or hardware executed by reading these pages.

force.finding: A straight current-carrying wire in a uniform field has vector force I times length-vector cross B. Divide by length for force density; bulk translation is not required.

faraday.locator: Faraday law and N-turn coil discussion
faraday.finding: Induced EMF is minus the rate of linked flux change; N identical turns multiply single-turn flux.

motor.locator: Constants and Rotor damping: Friction and iron losses
motor.finding: Torque constant relates current and torque. Speed and generator constants are inverse with consistent units. Real no-load current supplies friction/iron-loss torque. Linear torque–speed approximations have model limits.

sensorless.locator: Sensored and sensorless BLDC control discussion
sensorless.finding: Sensorless BLDC control estimates rotor position from back EMF, so three physical position sensors are not mandatory for all controllers.

startup.locator: TIDUF31B section 4.3.5, physical page 20, lines 742–751 in inspected extraction
startup.finding: A controlled PMSM can use alignment followed by open-loop acceleration before back-EMF-based closed-loop control. This differs from connecting a bare synchronous motor directly to fixed-frequency power.

stepper.finding: Command resolution and stopping accuracy are distinct; applied load can cause angular displacement. Microstep division alone is not an equal accuracy guarantee.

holding.locator: Maximum holding torque and microstep drive discussion
holding.finding: Holding torque describes an energized stationary motor. Microstep drive subdivides nominal step angle.

accessNotes: Microchip startup page search was corroborative but direct open returned maintenance/404; the bound startup evidence instead uses the successfully opened TI official PDF. No software, firmware or hardware was run.
